notes.title: Problem Solving
notes.content: Fixing general problems and Tutorial Crashing, also adding Hotkeys and overall camera drag functionality with it

notes.title: Hotkeys added for Towers!
notes.content: Now you can hold each number from 1 through 8, to pre-select a Tower. By clicking, you place it. By releasing the number key, you give up on placing the Tower!

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Descriptions Fix
notes.content:
Adding description to Towers for which you don't have gold (or lives) for. 

Also, after the tutorial, you can't go to the next stage directly, which gives the player the option to choose which race, world, stage, and difficulty level he wants to play in.
